meta.bug_root_cause: The 2026-09-07 M6 deployment (3c827e8) overwrote config.FUSION_MODEL_PATH / FUSION_BACKGROUND_PATH with the M6-fitted fusion model (models/fusion_meta_learner.joblib became byte-identical to fusion_meta_learner_m6_variant.joblib, sha256 d5e2bfee...). Every evaluator below constructed FusionEngine() with no arguments, which reads that ambient config path -- so after the deployment, every 'GCN arm' silently paired true GCN relational scores with M6-calibrated fusion coefficients instead of the GCN-fitted ones (preserved separately as fusion_meta_learner_gcn_backup.joblib, sha256 20ea7bcb...).

But re-running this script's main() today (unfixed) would silently regenerate it with GCN-score+M6-fusion inputs and overwrite that historical evidence with a mismatched-arm result -- confirmed by reproducing this exact mistake and reverting it (see finding below).

scripts_audited.additional_finding: A GCN-pinned rerun's P1/P2/P6 (pure threshold policies, no trained artifact) closely reproduce the historical numbers, with a small residual gap attributable to verified run-to-run wall-clock jitter (GNNScorer.score()'s active-neighbour window uses time.time(), not a controlled replay clock -- confirmed non-deterministic input scores across repeated identical runs). P5 (adaptive bandit) is STABLE at 0.5132 macro-F1 across repeated runs but differs from the historical 0.5271 by more than that jitter magnitude -- evidence that models/adaptive_pdp_qtable.json itself was retrained during the 2026-09-07 deployment via train_adaptive_pdp.py, which has the IDENTICAL GNNScorer()+FusionEngine()-ambient-default bug, corrupting the Q-table's provenance relative to a genuine GCN-only training run. Not corrected in this pass (no policy retrain performed, per explicit scope decision) -- see results/gcn_m6_corrected_comparison/policy_comparison.json.

It previously had no M6 arm at all; one was added separately (see results/gcn_m6_corrected_comparison/task2_comparison.json).

mechanism_of_fix: src/relational_pin.py's RelationalPin dataclass names a relational checkpoint + its matched fusion artifact together, by explicit path with a recorded SHA-256 each. GNNScorer/SetTransformerScorer/FusionEngine each gained an optional constructor parameter (checkpoint_path / model_path+background_path) that bypasses the ambient config constant when given -- additive, None-default, verified not to change any existing call site's behavior (full 169-test suite unchanged before touching any evaluator). RelationalPin.verify() re-hashes every pinned file before a scorer/fusion engine is constructed and raises ArtifactMismatchError on any mismatch, so a future artifact swap fails loudly instead of silently mixing model families again.
